rules.description: artifact-verification metadata must match actual ZIP
format-authority manifest contract count must equal sum of types across all family files
rules.check: sum(len(family['types']) for family in contracts) == canonical_count

rules.description: Test assertions must match format-authority canonical count
SignerContext must not be counted as main-class without classification proof
DigitalSignatureUtil example must not count as LowCode main-class without policy
rules.check: words-signer example.manifest.json.claimed_symbols does not include Aspose.Words.LowCode.Signer (no such class)

rules.description: Static PFX must not exist in package without provenance
rules.check: no *.pfx files in pr-dry-run example directories
rules.failure_action: FAIL — unproven static credential in package

rules.description: Program.cs must not generate PFX AND have static PFX
rules.check: if Program.cs contains CertificateRequest, no static .pfx in same directory
rules.failure_action: FAIL — redundant static PFX alongside runtime generation

rules.description: If slides-for-each is in package, README/denominator must mark it as helper not main-class
rules.failure_action: FAIL — helper example miscounted as main-class

rules.description: README controlled-pilot scope must include all and only main-class examples
Package version must agree between denominator.source_version, assembly manifest, Directory.Packages.props
rules.failure_action: WARN — catalog version (for API reflection) may differ from build version

rules.description: Every blocker probe must have build.log and run.log or blocker-packet.md
rules.check: For each blocker directory: (build.log AND run.log) OR blocker-packet.md exists

rules.description: Final verdict must not claim all-main-class closure while Processor/OFD/FormImporter/Timestamp remain open
No push/PR/merge unless approval gates are explicitly set
rules.check: PLUGIN_EXAMPLES_LIVE_PUBLISH_APPROVAL == APPROVE_LIVE_PR before any git push
